create_double_integrator_sim: create a DoubleIntegratorSim instance with specified dof, hz, and mass parameters
run_double_integrator_simulation: run a double integrator simulation using SimInterface with arm control and step callbacks
get_robot_state: get the current RobotState protobuf with joint positions, velocities, and torque data
apply_torque_control: apply a TorqueCommand to update the force buffer for the next simulation step
step_simulation: step the simulation forward by updating position and velocity using Euler integration
